description: Presented period: a^r == 1 (mod N), gcd(a,N)=1, and none of the posted proper_divisors is itself a period (the order claim). All four fields are required: a, N, r, proper_divisors - e.g. a=2, N=15, r=4, proper_divisors=1,2 -> WIN 'a^4 == 1 mod 15'. A call missing one returns REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE naming the missing field. Does not search for r. Floats refused.

a.description: base, coprime with N, decimal, e.g. 2

proper_divisors.description: REQUIRED on the wire: comma-separated proper divisors of r that must NOT be periods (that is the order claim), e.g. 1,2 for r=4. Absent -> REFUSED_NO_INSTANCE 'missing proper_divisors'

r.description: the presented period: a^r == 1 (mod N), decimal, e.g. 4

name: verify_period
